strings.name: Jannik Sinner
strings.summary: Raised in South Tyrol, Sinner shifted from skiing to tennis, won his first major in 2024 and became Italy’s first male world No. 1. He won Wimbledon in 2025 and 2026. In 2025 he accepted a three-month ban over clostebol positives; WADA accepted no intent to cheat and no competitive benefit but held him responsible for his team’s negligence. A knee injury interrupted his season in the second half of 2026.
strings.influence.rationale: Grand Slam champion and world No. 1, enhancing Italian tennis’s international competitive influence.
strings.facts.f2.value: Schooled in South Tyrol; moved to Bordighera for tennis training at 13.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Italy’s first male No. 1
strings.highlights.h1.text: First topped ATP singles rankings in 2024, advancing Italian tennis.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Consecutive Wimbledon titles
strings.highlights.h2.text: Won Wimbledon for the first time in 2025 and defended the title in 2026.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Knee injury recovery
strings.timeline.t1.text: Told Reuters about comeback plans, saying he would not rush knee recovery.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Defended Wimbledon
strings.timeline.t2.text: Beat Zverev in the final for his fifth major title.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Accepted three-month ban
strings.timeline.t3.text: Settled with WADA; ineligibility ran from 9 February to 4 May.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Reached ATP No. 1
strings.timeline.t4.text: Became the first Italian to reach No. 1 in ATP men’s singles.
strings.timeline.t5.title: First Australian Open title
strings.timeline.t5.text: Came back against Medvedev in the final to win his first singles major.
strings.timeline.t6.title: First ATP title
strings.timeline.t6.text: Won his first tour-level singles title in Sofia.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Next Gen Finals title
strings.timeline.t7.text: Won the Next Gen Finals in Milan as his professional ranking rose.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Born in South Tyrol
strings.timeline.t8.text: Born in San Candido, raised in Sesto and also competed in skiing as a child.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a live news archive.
